detail.longDescription: Technology does not create public value, the willingness to fix the process and the legal framework does. Agentic government is a delegation problem, not an AI problem: who authorised this, and which workload is asking. The centre holds trust, not traffic. The agent is never the authority. https:// agenticgov.eu # AI # GovTech # DigitalGovernment # EU # Sovereignty # OpenSource # AgenticAI # FediGov
